title: TimeShifters
description:
Cause mayhem like its the year 2000 again with fast paced gameplay and tons of weapons at your disposal!
Take on challenges and try get all the platinum trophies, learn the layout of every level and difficulty and try to beat your time!

Challenges can consist of pig racing, flying an apache, playing chicken with train, being a firefighter, pint smashing and much more!

Environments have lots of detail to interactive with like smashing windows, potting ball on a pool table, smashing plates, blowing up crates or even using the items in the environment like a fire extinguisher!

Create your perfect map using the mapmaker!
Place tiles, create multiplayer maps, create story missions, add triggers, edit how AI function and even change the look of your map.
Share your maps using the Steam Workshop!

• 9 STORY MISSIONS.

• 30+ CRAZY CHALLENGE MISSIONS.

• INTERACT WITH YOUR ENVIRONMENT.

• PLAY ONLINE AGAINST OTHERS IN MODES LIKE DEATHMATCH, CAPTURE THE BAG, VIRUS AND MANY MORE!.

• *USE THE MAPMAKER TO CREATE YOUR OWN MAPS!

*MAPMAKER IS A VERY EARLY FEATURE AND WILL BE UPDATED IN THE COMING WEEKS WITH MORE TILES.
description_short: TimeShifters is an old school first person shooter inspired by games like TimeSplitters and GoldenEye.
